title: Giro d’Italia Taps MAAP to Make the Pink Jersey in 2027
content:
MAAP will design the Giro's 'maglia rosa' in 2027 as Castelli replaces Santini at the Tour de France and Vuelta in grand tour leader's jersey reshuffle.

Read the full article at Giro d’Italia Taps MAAP to Make the Pink Jersey in 2027 on Velo.
